docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-30-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AUTORETURN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT AADEE, BRANDON EUGENE $2,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $195.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,695.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED NO EXHIBITS FILED

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$95.00); [PROOF DOCUMENT MARKED:"FILED BY FAX"] SERVED FEB-13-2023, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT AADEE, BRANDON EUGENE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-19-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-19-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF AUTORETURN IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY DAN SCANLAN, VP EMERITUS TOWING QUALTIY ASSURANCE. DEFENDANT BRANDON EUGENE AADEE IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $2500 TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAY-19-2023 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. IF APPEARANCES, THEN JUDGMENT ENTERED FOR THE PLAINTIFF IN THE AMOUNT OF $2500 PLUS $195 COSTS. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
